name: topological_sort
author: efd53284
description: Returns an ordering of a directed graph, or a directed cycle if one exists. For a directed acyclic graph (DAG) it returns a valid topological order: every node appears after all nodes that must come before it, using Kahn's algorithm with a heap so the order is deterministic. If the graph contains a directed cycle, it returns one cycle as a list of nodes in cycle order; the last node has an edge back to the first, and each node is flagged 'cycle'. Works on directed graphs, weighted or unweighted (weights are ignored) and on disconnected DAGs; undirected graphs return an error. Use it for prerequisite ordering, dependency checking, or detecting cycles.
